title: euphrasia minima subsp. drosocalyx
intro: Euphrasia minima subsp. drosocalyx, commonly known as dwarf eyebright, is a plant species that belongs to the family Orobanchaceae. It is valued for its health benefits, including its ability to soothe and calm the eyes, reduce inflammation, and alleviate respiratory issues such as coughs and colds. The therapeutic actions of Euphrasia minima subsp. drosocalyx include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiseptic properties, which help to protect the eyes and respiratory tract from infection and irritation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and iridoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and health benefits.
